title: The Rook Chooses
setup: Your rook on **e4** attacks along both of its lines: a knight sits on the rank, a pawn on the file.
hint: The e7-pawn looks tempting, but look at who is standing right behind it.
explanation:
## The Idea

The rook reaches two black pieces, one on its file and one on its rank.

{{Rxe7+}} walks into {{Kxe7}}: the king on e8 guards e7, and you have traded a five-point rook for a one-point pawn. {{Rxb4}} takes a knight that nothing guards and keeps all three points.

The king is a real defender, and anything standing next to it is guarded. Check your rook's whole rank and file, then take the target nobody protects.
